name: The graded devotional practices of BhG 12.8–12

stages.name: sarva-karma-phala-tyāga
stages.gloss: relinquishing the fruit of all actions
stages.description: For one unable even to work for the Lord: resorting to his yoga, with oneself restrained, give up the fruit of all actions (12.11).

stages.name: mat-karma-parama
stages.gloss: being intent on work for the Lord
stages.description: For one incapable even of the yoga of practice: be intent on work for the Lord; doing actions for his sake one attains perfection (12.10).

stages.name: abhyāsa-yoga
stages.description: For one who cannot hold the thought (citta) steadily on the Lord: seek to reach him by the yoga of practice (12.9).

stages.name: mayy eva mana ādhatsva
stages.gloss: fixing mind and understanding on the Lord
stages.description: Place your mind (manas) on the Lord alone, let your understanding (buddhi) enter him; thereafter you will dwell in him (12.8).

notes: The text states the four instructions from the top down (12.8, then 'if you cannot ...' 12.9, 12.10, 12.11); the order here runs upward from the most accessible, as the conditional sequence implies. 12.12 then ranks knowledge above practice, meditation above knowledge and relinquishing the fruit of actions above meditation, with peace following relinquishment — the reverse of the placement of relinquishment in 12.11; commentators commonly read 12.12 as praise of relinquishment. Correspondence bands are left to the interpretation layer.
